sovereign_country.strategic_role: 西欧核心消费市场、高客单价品牌合规与本土清关

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Manufacture of Portable Phased-Array Medical Diagnostic Scanners

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: France (unitary national jurisdiction for European Union legal and tax purposes)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law tradition (Napoleonic Code) as modified by EU directives and regulations; commercial companies are governed by the French Commercial Code (Code de commerce).
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (freedom of establishment and free movement of capital, Articles 49, 54 and 63) for EU-resident shareholders
France-China Investment Protection and Promotion Agreement (2007), if the corporate shareholder or ultimate beneficial owner is tax resident in the People's Republic of China
France-China Double Taxation Avoidance Convention (entered into force 1 January 2015) governing dividends, interest and royalties

Existing Bilateral Investment Treaties or double tax treaties between France and the shareholder's country of registration; the exact treaty instrument must be confirmed after UBO and shareholder jurisdiction disclosure

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: French Monetary and Financial Code (Code monétaire et financier), Articles L561-1 to L561-59 and R561-1 to R561-45; Articles L561-2-2, L561-45 to L561-49 on beneficial-owner declaration; French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Articles L123-1 to L123-20 and R123-1 et seq. on RCS registration; Ordonnance no. 2016-1635 of 1 December 2016 and subsequent amendments; Ordonnance no. 2020-115 of 10 February 2020; Decree no. 2021-699; EU Directive (EU) 2015/849 and Directive (EU) 2018/843 as implemented.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation / Extract from the Commercial Register of the corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies Registry / Registrar of Companies in the shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if the originating state is a 1961 Hague Convention party; otherwise consular legalization by the French Embassy or Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of non-insolvency and non-judicial sanctions against the corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies Registry / Ministry of Justice or competent court of the originating state
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization, followed by sworn French translation if required by the greffe

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Beneficial Ownership Register extract or UBO declaration of the corporate shareholder, showing all natural-person ultimate beneficial owners with more than 25% ownership or control
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Official UBO register or competent company registry in the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization; translation by a court-certified sworn translator

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Apostilled passport copies and proof of address of individual shareholders, managers and ultimate beneficial owners
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport office, notary public or local police authority of the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization; sworn French translation required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source-of-funds certificate for the block of share capital
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing bank or credit institution maintaining the relevant account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Bank letter with notarial or branch authentication; apostille/legalization only if required by the French bank or regulator

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, managers and UBOs against (1) national PEP databases and enhanced due diligence under Articles L561-10 to L561-10-2 CMF; (2) OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List and OFAC sectoral sanctions, because payment rails include Swift LC and TT wires in USD; (3) UN Security Council consolidated list; (4) EU consolidated financial sanctions list; and (5) French national asset-freezing measures and Tracfin notices. Adverse hits require refusal or limitation of the business relationship and a declaration to Tracfin under Article L561-15. Screening must be completed before incorporation and repeated at least quarterly for the life of the entity.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Infogreffe / Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce RCS database; online formalities through Guichet unique des formalités d'entreprises at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr; conflict screening additionally through INPI's trademarks and company-name database.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Pursuant to Law no. 94-665 of 4 August 1994 (Toubon Act), all documents filed with French authorities must be in French. The corporate name (dénomination sociale) must be expressed in Latin script; any non-Latin script must be transliterated and rendered in the Latin alphabet. A French language version or legally conforming French descriptive subtitle is required for commercial documents used in France. The name must not mislead the public and must not infringe an existing prior right or protected trademark.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: French law does not provide a formal RCS corporate-name reservation right. Name availability is assessed at filing and no extension is available. In the event of refusal by the greffe, the applicant may (1) request a formal re-examination by the same greffe within 15 days of notification; (2) appear before the judge charged with registry supervision (juge commis à la surveillance du registre du commerce) or apply in référé proceedings before the President of the Tribunal de commerce to compel registration; (3) resolve any trademark conflict by filing opposition or cancellation proceedings before INPI or the competent civil court; and (4) appeal the judicial decision to the Paris Court of Appeal or the relevant appellate court. As a practical matter, a fresh availability report should be obtained immediately before final submission because the clearance result has no legal holding period.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A licensed professional domiciliation service may provide the legal registered office (siège social), but for an ISIC 3250 medical-imaging manufacturer this must be complemented by a physical operational establishment in France where manufacturing, storage, technical documentation, quality management and vigilance files are kept. A bare virtual office without any business substance is not sufficient for SARL formation in this industry and will create artificial-establishment and tax-abuse risk under Articles L64 of the French Tax Procedures Book and CJEU abuse-of-rights doctrine. The European Medical Device Regulation 2017/745 requires a registered place of business for the manufacturer, importer and authorised representative roles, and ANSM must be able to access the physical site for inspection.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High-risk classification: estimated 35–50% likelihood of an unannounced physical inspection during the first three years of operation, due to ANSM medical-device post-market surveillance, DGCCRF market-surveillance powers and customs controls on medical imaging equipment imports/exports.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: RCS registration fee (droit d'immatriculation auprès du greffe du tribunal de commerce)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff fixed by ministerial arrêté for commercial registry filings

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Territorial Chamber of Commerce and Industry tax (taxe pour frais de chambre de commerce et d'industrie)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Chambre de Commerce et d'Industrie territoriale
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fixed fee applicable to commercial company registrations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Compulsory legal announcement of incorporation in an authorised legal gazette (annonce légale de constitution)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Journal d'annonces légales licensed by the prefecture
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rate per inserted line within statutory maximum

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Domiciliation / registered office service for the first 12 months with physical document storage and operational mail handling
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed domiciliation provider or commercial real-estate lessor
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for medical-device industry office domiciliation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Sworn French translation, notarization and apostille/consular legalization bundle for foreign constitutional documents, UBO extracts and passport copies
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Sworn translator registered with the Cour de Cassation or a Cour d'Appel; notary public; competent foreign authentication authority
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Per-page sworn translation tariff plus per-document apostille/legalization fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Independent UBO piercing, PEP/OFAC/UN/French sanctions screening and AML/CFT compliance sign-off
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External AML/CFT compliance counsel or law firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for compliance counsel retainer; no statutory tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation regulatory consultancy for registration as a medical-device manufacturer/importer under EU MDR 2017/745, ANSM preliminary filing and EORI/VAT pre-briefing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Legal-regulatory consultant and future ANSM/Greffe fee schedule
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark fixed fee; ANSM statutory fee schedule will apply at formal registration stage

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code, Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 and R.223-1 to R.223-36 governing sociétés à responsabilité limitée; Articles L.123-1 et seq. governing the Registre national des entreprises and commercial registration; French Civil Code Articles 1832 et seq. governing companies generally.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises operated by the Institut national de la propriété industrielle (INPI), with registration in the Registre national des entreprises and, where applicable, the Registre du commerce et des sociétés maintained by the competent commercial court registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Electronic declaration of creation of a legal entity submitted through the INPI Guichet unique, accompanied by the executed SARL articles of association, beneficial-owner declaration, and supporting corporate documents.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital is required; EUR 1 is legally sufficient. At least 20% of cash contributions must be paid upon incorporation and the balance within five years of registration. Capital must be deposited with an authorized bank, notary, or Caisse des Dépôts depositary, which issues the certificate of deposit required for registration. Contributions in kind are subject to valuation rules and, unless legally waived, an apport auditor.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The Board resolves to approve the subscription by the members for the entire issued share capital of the Company in accordance with the articles of association and the applicable capital-deposit certificate. The Board adopts the registered office at [full French address] and authorizes all filings and correspondence at that address. The Board appoints [name] as Gérant for an indefinite term, with authority to manage and represent the Company within the limits of French law and the articles. [Name] is authorized to open and operate the Company’s bank accounts and complete all incorporation, tax, beneficial-owner, and regulatory formalities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Approve corporate name, objects, capital, ownership, and registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founding members, assisted by French counsel or the domiciliation provider
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a corporate-name availability check, define the medical-device manufacturing and export objects, confirm the registered office, identify the Gérant, determine member allocations, and prepare the French-language articles of association. Execute the articles privately; notarization is not generally required unless real estate or another legally notarized contribution is involved. Foreign corporate documents should be apostilled or legalized where required and accompanied by certified French translations.
required_dossiers: Identification documents for all members and the Gérant
Foreign corporate certificates, powers of attorney, and certified French translations where applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct name, object, address, identity, or translation defects and obtain fresh signatures where necessary. Replace defective domiciliation evidence before filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: A journal habilité à publier des annonces légales in the department of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the prescribed incorporation notice containing the company name, legal form, capital, registered office, corporate purpose, duration, Gérant identity, and registration details. Retain the attestation de parution issued by the authorized legal-notices journal. The notice must be published before or in connection with the registration filing.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Republish a corrected notice if mandatory information is omitted or inaccurate, and upload the corrected attestation to the INPI filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit subscribed capital and obtain the deposit certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Authorized French bank, notary, or Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary account in the name of the company under formation, transfer the required portion of cash contributions, and provide the draft articles, member identities, Gérant identity, beneficial-owner information, and source-of-funds evidence. Obtain the certificate of deposit and preserve the transfer records. The funds are released after presentation of the Kbis extract or equivalent registration evidence.
required_dossiers: Draft or signed articles of association
Identity and address evidence for members and Gérant
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to bank AML queries, provide enhanced source-of-funds evidence, correct account-name discrepancies, or use another authorized depositary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Create the SARL formation filing, upload the signed articles, legal-notice attestation, capital-deposit certificate, registered-office evidence, management declaration, identity documents, and beneficial-owner declaration. Complete the activity, ownership, tax, establishment, and workforce fields accurately. Sign electronically, pay the applicable filing charges, and retain the filing receipt and tracking number.
required_dossiers: Power of attorney where filed by an agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Answer the INPI or registry query within the stated deadline, upload missing or corrected documents, pay any balance requested, and resubmit the formalité if it is rejected.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain registration and activate post-incorporation records
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Competent commercial court registry, INPI RNE, INSEE, and the relevant tax authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Verify receipt of the SIREN, SIRET, APE code, RNE registration, and Kbis extract. Convert the temporary bank account into the operating account, complete VAT and corporate-tax registrations as applicable, maintain the register of members and decisions, and submit beneficial-owner updates whenever ownership or control changes.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Request correction from the INPI or commercial registry, file an INSEE data amendment, or submit a tax-registration correction through the relevant administrative channel.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Complete medical-device manufacturing and market-access compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agence nationale de sécurité du médicament et des produits de santé (ANSM), the applicable European Commission framework, and an appropriately designated notified body where third-party conformity assessment is required
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Determine the device classification under Regulation (EU) 2017/745, establish a quality-management system compliant with applicable MDR requirements, prepare technical documentation, clinical evaluation, post-market surveillance, vigilance, and labeling files, appoint an EU authorized representative if the manufacturer is outside the EU, complete applicable economic-operator registrations, obtain conformity assessment, issue the EU Declaration of Conformity, affix the CE marking, and register the device and operator data in the applicable EUDAMED modules as they become mandatory.
required_dossiers: French and EU-compliant labeling and instructions for use
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct notified-body nonconformities, remediate ANSM requests, update technical documentation, suspend affected placing-on-market activity where necessary, and use MDR vigilance and corrective-action procedures for safety issues.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Agence nationale de sécurité du médicament et des produits de santé (ANSM) for French medical-device market surveillance and applicable operator obligations; the European Commission and designated notified bodies for MDR conformity assessment; the Préfecture and Direction régionale de l'environnement, de l'aménagement et du logement (DREAL) for classified industrial installations.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: EU medical-device conformity assessment, EU Declaration of Conformity, and CE marking under Regulation (EU) 2017/745; no general French manufacturing license is ordinarily required solely for assembling a medical-imaging console, but site-specific declarations or authorizations may apply under the ICPE regime.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry for Ecological Transition environmental authorities, including the relevant regional environmental authority and the Préfecture/DREAL
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Normally no automatic full EIA for ordinary assembly of electronic medical consoles. Classification depends on the site, quantities, solvents, batteries, waste, emissions, energy use, storage, and applicable ICPE headings; a declaration, registration, authorization, or project-level environmental assessment may be required after screening.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No single universal threshold applies to this activity. Wastewater discharges must comply with the municipal sewer authorization or site permit and applicable French water-pollution requirements. VOC emissions, solvent storage, noise, hazardous substances, and waste handling must comply with applicable ICPE prescriptions, workplace rules, and EU chemical and waste legislation. Hazardous waste must be identified, segregated, tracked, and transferred to authorized operators.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Obtain building and occupancy approvals where required, including fire-safety review for premises open to the public and any applicable ERP requirements through the mairie and fire-safety authorities. Maintain fire detection, extinguishing, emergency-access, evacuation, electrical, and structural-load controls appropriate to the premises. Complete occupational-risk assessment, workplace safety documentation, employer declarations, medical surveillance, and training under the French Labour Code. There is no single general occupational operating clearance for this manufacturing activity; site-specific fire, building, environmental, and labor inspections remain applicable.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) – Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE) for direct/VAT collection; Direction Générale des Douanes et Droits Indirects (DGDDI) for customs and export control. Official portals: impots.gouv.fr and formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned SARL obtains its statutory TIN and VAT ID through a single online registration at the Guichet Unique operated by INPI (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr). Step 1: File the statuts and incorporate the SARL with the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS); the system automatically issues the SIREN (9-digit) and SIRET (14-digit INSEE identifiers). Step 2: The SIE attached to the registered office automatically allocates the 13-character intra-community VAT number (FR[two-digit key][SIREN]) and notifies the taxpayer via the impots.gouv.fr professional account. Step 3: No French permanent establishment is required for registration; non-resident officers may register directly, but a fiscal representative is advisable for VAT refund claims. Step 4: Obtain a customs EORI number (FR + SIREN) from DGDDI through the online SIE registration process. Step 5: File the definitive business status (form 11450) and VAT declaration (form 11585); the VAT return period is monthly or quarterly.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation – SARL defaults to Impôt sur les Sociétés (IS). Standard IS rate 25%; reduced 15% applies to first €42,500 annual profit for SMEs satisfying Art. 219 CGI conditions. Territoriality: profits of activities carried out through a French establishment are taxable in France; foreign branch profits are generally outside the French IS base under the French territoriality rule.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: (i) SARL transparency election under Art. 239 bis AA CGI for small family SARLs meeting ≤5 natural-person shareholders and kinship tests; (ii) French fiscal integration (intégration fiscale) under Art. 223 A CGI where a French 95%-or-more parent heads a group and elects consolidated IS treatment; (iii) EU ATAD anti-hybrid measures under Arts. 212 bis and 209 B CGI disallow mismatched payments; no US-style check-the-box exists; (iv) M&A reorganization regimes available on merger/transfer; (v) no elective territorial option for foreign permanent establishments is available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (TVA – Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: €85,000 annual turnover for supplies of goods (Art. 293 B CGI franchise en base de TVA; tolerance band up to €93,500). A medical device manufacturer/exporter registers voluntarily to recover input VAT; foreign non-established sellers conducting distance sales to French B2B customers must identify at the SIE and appoint a fiscal representative where required under Art. 286 CGI.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory e-invoicing under 2023 Finance Act (Art. 23): from 1 Sept 2026 large and mid-size companies must issue structured e-invoices (Factur-X, UBL, CII/D16B formats) through a certified PDP (Plateforme de Dématérialisation Partenaire) interconnected with the PPF (Portail Public de Facturation); SMEs/VSEs follow from 1 Sept 2027. E-reporting of B2C and cross-border data to the PPF is concurrently mandatory. DGFiP does not perform real-time fiscal clearance or digital stamping in the Latin-American model; validation occurs at the PDP layer, PPF aggregates data, and a 10-year electronic archive is mandatory.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT applies to supplies of goods exported outside the EU (Art. 262-I-1° CGI) and to services directly linked to those exports (Art. 262-I-2° CGI). Conditions: (i) goods leave EU customs territory within 90 days of the time of supply; (ii) the export declaration is cleared by DGDDI with exit validation; (iii) transport documents evidence delivery to the non-EU destination; (iv) risk and title have passed to the foreign buyer; (v) settlement is received through regulated banking channels. Intra-EU dispatches to VAT-registered customers are exempt under Art. 262 ter I CGI subject to valid EU VAT ID and inclusion in the recapitulative statement (DEB).
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DAU/SAD) lodged via DELTA-D, cleared by DGDDI, with MRN and actual exit confirmation
Bill of Lading (sea) or CMR/AWB evidencing removal from EU territory and delivery at the foreign destination
Inward Remittance Certificate / SWIFT MT103 confirmation / Letter of Credit settlement evidence
Commercial invoice and detailed packing list used in customs clearance
Proof of physical exit within 90 days (cargo manifest, customs exit message, inspection report)
For intra-EU transactions: buyer's VAT number verified via VIES and copy of the DEB recapitulative statement
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGFiP and DGDDI audits reconcile export declarations, e-invoices, customs exit records, and bank settlement evidence; the standard statute of limitations is three years, extended to ten years for undisclosed offshore arrangements. Unsupported 0% claims are reassessed at the 20% standard VAT rate plus intérêts de retard under Art. 1727 CGI. Penalties under Art. 1728 et seq. CGI escalate: 40% for simple inaccuracy, 80% for bad faith (mauvaise foi), up to 100% for fraudulent maneuvers; criminal exposure under Art. 1741 CGI reaches €45,000 fine and three years imprisonment. Clawback is retrospective to the first unreported period and covers principal, interest, penalties, and may suspend VAT refund credits.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France, acting within the Eurosystem under the European Central Bank; foreign-exchange policy is principally governed by the European Union and applicable French rules administered by the French Ministry for the Economy, Finance and Industrial and Digital Sovereignty, including the Directorate-General of the Treasury. Prudential and payment-services supervision is conducted by the Autorité de contrôle prudentiel et de résolution, with market-conduct supervision by the Autorité des marchés financiers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France uses the euro, which is fully convertible for current-account and capital-account transactions, subject to EU sanctions, anti-money-laundering controls, prudential requirements, tax rules, and transaction-reporting obligations. A French SARL may generally receive foreign investment, make cross-border shareholder loans, pay suppliers, remit dividends, repay qualifying debt, and transfer sale proceeds without a general foreign-exchange approval or mandatory central-bank authorization. Dividend and interest payments remain subject to corporate-law requirements, distributable-profit limitations, withholding-tax analysis, beneficial-owner verification, transfer-pricing rules, and bank documentation. Distributions require properly approved financial statements and must not breach legal-reserve, solvency, creditor-protection, or applicable financing-covenant restrictions. Cross-border payments involving sanctioned persons, embargoed jurisdictions, restricted dual-use goods, or unusual payment chains may be blocked or require regulatory authorization.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: France has no general statutory requirement for exporters to surrender export proceeds to the Banque de France, convert a prescribed percentage into euros, or repatriate receipts within a fixed foreign-exchange deadline. Export proceeds may generally remain in foreign-currency accounts or be converted at the company's discretion, subject to accounting, tax, sanctions, AML, customs, and payment-service controls. Export transactions must be supported by commercial and customs records, and statistical or regulatory reporting may apply through customs, Banque de France, the bank, or intra-EU reporting systems depending on transaction type and reporting thresholds. Cash or equivalent instruments physically entering or leaving the European Union at EUR 10,000 or more must be declared to customs. Bank-specific evidence of the underlying export, invoice, customs declaration, transport documents, and beneficial recipient may be required before crediting or releasing funds.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Agricole S.A. and relevant Crédit Agricole regional caisse
Banque Populaire and Caisse d'Épargne network operated by BPCE

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium for payment operations and low-to-medium as a substitute for a primary French banking relationship. A licensed European Economic Area electronic-money institution or payment institution may provide euro accounts, payment accounts, SEPA transfers, foreign-exchange services, and, where authorized, safeguarding arrangements. It does not necessarily provide a deposit account, statutory capital-deposit service, full trade-finance capability, commercial letters of credit, cash-management credit, or direct access to every clearing system. An offshore digital EMI outside the European Economic Area cannot lawfully provide regulated payment or e-money services to the French SARL on a passporting basis without an applicable French or EEA authorization, branch, agent, or other lawful market-access structure. The SARL must verify the provider in the relevant national register, confirm safeguarding and insolvency treatment, assess IBAN and payer-name compatibility, and maintain a regulated French or EEA bank as the principal account for capital formation, tax, payroll, and critical suppliers.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: French law does not impose a universal rule that all directors must attend a bank branch physically. Remote onboarding may be permitted using qualified or enhanced electronic identification, videoconference, certified corporate documents, and beneficial-owner verification. In practice, the bank may require a physical meeting, notarized or apostilled documents, a French address, a French-resident authorized signatory, or an in-person interview where ownership is foreign, the business is newly incorporated, the activity involves medical devices and international trade, the ownership chain is complex, or the bank cannot independently verify source of funds. The legal representative and each relevant beneficial owner must be identified; delegated account operators may also be interviewed. Account opening should not be treated as complete until the bank confirms activation and transaction limits in writing.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Incomplete or inconsistent beneficial-ownership information, including a nominee shareholder, layered holding company, trust, bearer-like arrangement, or mismatch between the shareholder register, corporate registry, and bank forms.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current Kbis extract or equivalent registry evidence; articles of association; complete ownership chart to each natural-person ultimate beneficial owner; shareholder register; passports and proof of address for directors, authorized signatories, and beneficial owners; beneficial-owner declaration; board or shareholder authorization; written explanation of any intermediate holding entity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Foreign shareholder, director, or signatory with no clear economic rationale for a French SARL or with a high-risk country, sanctioned exposure, politically exposed person status, or adverse media.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed group structure memorandum; business plan; management biographies; sanctions and PEP screening results; source-of-wealth and source-of-funds evidence; audited financial statements or tax records; ownership and control declarations; written explanation of the French operating rationale; compliance policy and escalation contact.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large initial capital contribution, shareholder loan, or inbound payment inconsistent with the stated business scale or lacking a documented funding purpose.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed shareholder resolution or loan agreement; capitalization table; bank statements showing origin of funds; audited accounts or tax returns of the funder; sale or financing documents where relevant; payment instruction identifying equity, loan, or expense funding; tax and transfer-pricing analysis; confirmation that the funds are not third-party or pass-through funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Medical-device manufacturing and export activity without a clear regulatory, customs, product, or supply-chain profile.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Business plan; product catalogue; device classification; CE-marking and conformity-assessment evidence where applicable; manufacturer or importer status; registration and quality-management evidence; supplier and customer contracts; customs and tariff classification; shipping routes; end-user and end-use screening; export-control assessment; applicable establishment, distribution, or sector authorization.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Expected high-volume international wires, rapid movement of funds, third-party payments, circular flows, or payments unrelated to invoices.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Three-year transaction forecast; payment-flow diagram; approved customer and supplier list; sample invoices and purchase orders; logistics and customs documents; treasury policy; segregation-of-duties matrix; reconciliation procedures; explanation for any third-party payment; sanctions screening protocol; monthly management reporting.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of virtual IBANs, offshore accounts, unregulated digital platforms, cash-intensive channels, or jurisdictions associated with elevated AML risk.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full regulated-provider license and register extract; account ownership confirmation; safeguarding explanation; correspondent-bank details; purpose of each account; transaction-monitoring controls; tax and accounting treatment; written bank-approved rationale; commitment to route operating receipts through a regulated French or EEA institution.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear tax residence, missing French registration, unverified registered office, or inability to evidence actual management and operations.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Kbis extract; SIREN and VAT numbers; lease or domiciliation agreement; utility or occupancy evidence; management-service agreements; payroll or contractor records where applicable; French tax-residence evidence; business premises photographs or inspection evidence if requested; organization chart and local operating timetable.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Requested trade-finance facility involving medical devices, dual-use components, embargoed destinations, or unusual intermediaries.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: End-user certificates; end-use statements; export-license analysis; product technical specifications; HS codes; customer incorporation and ownership documents; sanctions screening; transport route; insurance; Incoterms; documentary-credit terms; compliance approval by the bank's trade-finance and sanctions teams.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Failure to maintain current corporate records after formation, including expired identification documents, changes in directors, ownership, address, or signing authority.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Annual corporate-record calendar; updated Kbis and articles; signed change resolutions; renewed identification documents; beneficial-owner register update; bank mandate; specimen signatures; tax and accounting contact details; documented notification protocol for changes within the bank's required period.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route equity through the French bank's capital-deposit account during incorporation or through the designated operational account after registration. Use a SEPA Credit Transfer for euro funding where the sending and receiving institutions participate in SEPA; use SWIFT cross-border payment messaging for non-SEPA currencies or jurisdictions. The payment reference should identify the French SARL, the subscriber, the instrument, and the purpose, such as share capital contribution, share premium, or shareholder loan. Provide the bank with the executed subscription documentation, shareholder or board resolution, source-of-funds evidence, sender-account ownership evidence, loan agreement where applicable, and expected settlement date. The bank should verify the sender against the beneficial owner or documented funder, screen sanctions and AML risks, validate the legal purpose, and reconcile the amount with the accounting entry. Capital deposited for formation must be evidenced by the bank's certificate of deposit and released according to French incorporation procedures. For non-euro funding, document the exchange rate, conversion date, fees, and amount credited in euros. Do not route capital through personal accounts, unrelated third parties, anonymous payment services, or unexplained offshore intermediaries.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use SEPA Credit Transfer or SEPA Instant Credit Transfer for eligible euro suppliers within the SEPA area, subject to bank limits and sanctions screening. Use SWIFT cross-border payment instructions for non-SEPA payments; MT103 remains a legacy message description, while banks are migrating to ISO 20022 payment messages such as pacs.008. For documentary trade, use an irrevocable commercial letter of credit issued or advised through a regulated bank under UCP 600, with documentary examination under applicable ICC rules and, where appropriate, an eUCP framework. Match the credit or wire to the purchase order, commercial invoice, packing list, transport document, customs data, insurance, Incoterms, beneficiary details, HS code, and end-use information. For imports into France, retain customs declarations, import VAT records, proof of delivery, and supplier-screening evidence. For exports, retain invoices, transport documents, customs export declarations, proof of shipment, and customer or end-user screening records. Confirm fees, correspondent-bank routes, value dates, payment purpose, and intermediary-bank data before release. Apply dual approval for new beneficiaries and independent callback verification for amended bank details.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable foreign-exchange forwards with an authorized bank or appropriately regulated investment firm, supported by a documented underlying exposure, treasury policy, counterparty limit, confirmation, maturity, settlement instructions, and accounting treatment.

Non-deliverable forwards for currencies or markets where physical delivery is restricted or impractical, subject to counterparty authorization, benchmark and settlement documentation, applicable EU market-conduct requirements, sanctions controls, and evidence of the underlying exposure.

Currency swaps and cross-currency interest-rate swaps for documented funding or liquidity exposures, subject to ISDA or equivalent master documentation, collateral and margin terms, counterparty credit limits, valuation controls, and applicable EU EMIR reporting, clearing, and risk-mitigation requirements.

Foreign-exchange options or structured hedges may be used only after suitability, cost, valuation, accounting, and downside-risk approval; avoid speculative positions unrelated to operating, financing, or committed commercial exposures.

Hedging controls should include board-approved limits, segregation of dealing and settlement duties, independent valuation, confirmation matching, counterparty netting analysis, collateral monitoring, hedge-accounting assessment under the applicable accounting framework, and periodic exposure reconciliation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual filing of statutory accounts, management report and auditor's report (dépôt des comptes annuels) with the trade and companies registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de commerce / Registre du commerce et des sociétés (RCS) managed by INPI
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 7 months of the fiscal year-end and within 1 month of shareholder approval of the accounts; for a 31-December year-end, by 31 July
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine up to EUR 7,500 for the legal entity and EUR 1,500 per manager (Art. L.247-1 C.com.); possible court-ordered daily fine (astreinte); repeated non-filing over approximately 2 years exposes the entity to administrative strike-off (radiation) from the RCS

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (déclaration de résultats, form 2065 series) with balance sheet, income statement, depreciation and local tax schedules
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) – French tax administration via impots.gouv.fr
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 3rd day of the 5th month following the fiscal year-end; for a 31-December year-end, by 3 May (shifted to the next business day if falling on a weekend)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 10% of assessed IS (increased up to 40% for undeclared activities) plus monthly late-payment interest of 0.2%; criminal penalties apply for deliberate omission

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual local business property tax declaration and payment (Cotisation Foncière des Entreprises, CFE)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Payment in a single instalment by 15 December of the assessment year; annual situation declaration by 3 May (or 30 June when no electronic filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment penalty of 10% plus monthly interest of 0.2% and recovery interest at 0.4% per month; enforced collection through tax lien or seizure proceedings

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation of beneficial ownership data (confirmation annuelle des bénéficiaires effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de commerce / INPI beneficial-ownership register attached to the RCS
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed together with the annual accounts deposit; where the SARL is not required to file accounts, confirmation must occur before expiry of the 7-month statutory accounts period; any shareholding change affecting beneficial owners must be reported within 30 days
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal fine up to EUR 7,500 and up to 6 months' imprisonment for the legal representative; possible administrative warning and suspension of registry data publication

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual ordinary general meeting (AGOA) approving annual accounts, allocation of results and renewal of the manager (gérant)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Not a filing; minutes entered in the SARL statutory minute book (registre des délibérations)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months of the fiscal year-end (by 30 June for a 31-December year-end)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Manager's civil liability for failure to convene; if net equity falls below half of share capital, the meeting must be convened within 4 months of the certified loss, failing which dissolution may be sought in court

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory statutory audit (commissaire aux comptes) for a French SARL where two of three thresholds are exceeded at fiscal year-end: total balance sheet over EUR 4,000,000; turnover excluding tax over EUR 8,000,000; average workforce over 50 permanent employees
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général pursuant to ANC Regulation 2014-03); IFRS is permitted or required only for consolidated accounts of listed groups and certain regulated entities

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SARL must annually confirm to the RCS the exactness of the beneficial-owner declaration, concurrently with the annual accounts deposit or before the 7-month statutory accounts deadline if no deposit is due; share transfers changing beneficial ownership must be filed within 30 days of the transfer; failure to confirm triggers criminal fines and may result in the entity being prevented from continuing to appear in good standing on the register
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of members and share transfers (registre des mouvements de titres)
Register of management decisions and shareholders' meetings (registre des décisions et assemblées)
Minute book of general meetings (registre des procès-verbaux)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: $200 - $2,700 per annum (typical EUR 180 - EUR 2,500 range for domiciliation / registered-office services in France)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: $4,500 - $11,000 per audit engagement (typical market range EUR 4,000 - EUR 10,000 for a small-to-medium SARL)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% standard rate (since 1 January 2022; 28% rate for FY2020, 26.5% for FY2021)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced 15% rate on first €42,500 of taxable profit for eligible SMEs (turnover < €10m and capital conditions); unlimited statutory loss carryforward with annual offset cap (first €1m unrestricted, 50% of balance above €1m) - schema field retained as planning assumption.
